# MetroPulse: 3-Minute Pitch & Operational PPP Model

**Hackathon Problem Statement:** PS-05 · Metro Operations · The Stadium Surge  
**Operator Context:** Gujarat Metro Rail Corporation (GMRC) Limited · Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar Corridor  
*Note: All performance figures and metrics shown are generated by the simulation engine and labelled as "Simulated data".*

---

## 1. 3-Minute Pitch Script

### Minute 1: The Problem & The Breaking Point
> "Judges, imagine 110,000 spectators leaving the Narendra Modi Stadium at 23:30 after a nail-biting IPL final. Within 15 minutes, 38,000 people flood into the Motera Stadium metro station. 
> 
> What happened in the real 2026 IPL final? Concourse gates choked, queues stretched across the entire footbridge for 90 minutes, and platforms exceeded Fruin Level of Service E. Operators knew the fixture months in advance, but on the night, OCC was forced to make reactive decisions.
> 
> Why? Because standard transit timetables are built for commuter peaks, not 10x event surges. Increasing full-corridor frequencies across 35 stations is impossible due to a hard constraint: the corridor only has 26 operational rakes."

### Minute 2: The MetroPulse Solution & Live Demo
> "Enter **MetroPulse**: an offline-resilient, minute-by-minute crowd surge planner built specifically for transit controllers.
> 
> An operator enters the fixture or pastes an unstructured WhatsApp police circular. MetroPulse parses it and simulates the station in 1-minute increments across five connected physical zones: Forecourt, Footbridge, Concourse, Turnstiles, and Platforms.
> 
> Rather than overwhelming the system, MetroPulse solves the surge with three policy-compliant levers:
> 1. **Dynamic 15-Minute Headways:** Compresses North-South headways from 6 minutes down to 3 minutes during peak egress.
> 2. **Targeted Short-Turn Shuttles:** Deploys 4 pre-positioned empty rakes from Sabarmati siding that run direct originations from Motera to Sabarmati (STN_12) and GNLU (STN_23)—carrying 382 passengers each with zero arrival load, consuming zero extra full-line fleet.
> 3. **Active Concourse Holding:** When platform density approaches the safe 2.0 pax/m² limit, turnstiles throttle entry. Passengers wait safely in concourse pens and are released in managed waves.
> 
> The result? Peak platform density drops from an unsafe 3.1 pax/m² down to 1.82 pax/m², crush risk drops to zero, and total stadium egress time is cut by 48 minutes."

### Minute 3: Resilience & Multilingual Operations
> "Crucially, MetroPulse is built for the real world:
> - **100% Offline Capable:** Runs entirely in airplane mode inside a moving train.
> - **Graceful AI Degradation:** If the local LLM is unreachable, validated transit templates automatically provide public address announcements in Gujarati, Hindi, and English with real plan timings filled in.
> - **Human in the Loop:** Respects Indian Metro standards—no automated schedule override takes effect without Chief Train Controller approval.
> - With one click, the operator approves and prints an A4 operational notice ready for station security marshals."
